sentences.en: The ship was drifting at the mercy of the waves.
sentences.zh: 那艘船任凭海浪摆布，在海上漂移。

sentences.en: They drifted further and further apart as time went on.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他们之间的关系越来越疏远。

sentences.en: Maybe, but I can't catch the drift of even simple situations.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，但我甚至无法理解一些简单情况的意思。

collocations.zh: 渐渐离去，迷迷糊糊地睡去
